label: Bible Study
prompt: He which testifieth these things saith, Surely I come _____. Amen. Even so, come, Lord Jesus.
verse: He which testifieth these things saith, Surely I come quickly. Amen. Even so, come, Lord Jesus.
note: The Bible's last promise — and the next-to-last verse in the whole book.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Now the God of _____ fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost.
verse: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost.
note: Paul calls Him 'the God of hope' and prays you'll abound in it — overflowing, not just getting by.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, That this night, before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me _____.
verse: Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, That this night, before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice.
note: Peter swore he'd never deny Jesus; the KJV's 'thrice' came true before the cock crowed.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And he believed in the LORD; and he counted it to him for _____.
verse: And he believed in the LORD; and he counted it to him for righteousness.
note: Paul builds Romans 4 and Galatians 3 on this line — Abraham's faith was credited long before circumcision or the law.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: For thus saith the high and lofty One that _____ eternity, whose name is Holy; I dwell in the high and holy place, with him also that is of a contrite and humble spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble, and to revive the heart of the contrite ones.
verse: For thus saith the high and lofty One that inhabiteth eternity, whose name is Holy; I dwell in the high and holy place, with him also that is of a contrite and humble spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble, and to revive the heart of the contrite ones.
note: The God 'that inhabiteth eternity' also dwells with the contrite and humble — the highest address and the lowest.
